title: Melody Maker clip, marriage and a casino band
summary: A clip praises Goudie and Danny Polo; he talks about his marriage and leading a band at a casino.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Testing. A clip from Melody Maker. Uh, Frank, Big Boy, Goody and Danny Polo departed from this country before the swing craze hit its peak. The same departing. The same departing somewhat from the style in which they had been reared in America. If Bill Coleman showed continental Europeans how the jazz trumpet should and could and should be played. Dickie Wells at Trombone, Betty Carter at the alto sax, Coleman Hawkins at tenor sax, and Chittison at piano. Goody certainly revealed to them the mysteries of jazz clarinet.
And, uh, I was married and my wife, she wanted to go back to Europe, so to have Jesus as well.
How long were they married? Ten years. Twenty-six months.

Ten years ago. And I didn't start over. If I can't make a person happy, there's no need to tie up yourself in which I mean I can make it happy, but she would have to understand that, you know, I have, I love music and you can still love music and be a gentleman at home too. Yeah. You know. Yeah. But I had one of those wife that she never was satisfied with nothing. Yeah, you can get those, I'll tell you. Yes. So this is a big, big casino you can see in the picture. Yeah. I went there with that band. That's the second band I got together. Because the band I had before, there wasn't good readers, you see. But this band is all good readers, because I had to have good readers there, because you had to accompany all those show numbers, you see. Oh, yeah. And as I started, I had to go to the labor office and change my identification from a musician to a band leader. And I still have the paper to prove it. And they wanted to know whether I was able to conduct a band. We could play show numbers on classical music and all that.
